description: This file defines the AWS AuditManagerClient class, which is a client for interacting with the AWS Audit Manager service. It includes method annotations for various operations related to audit assessments, controls, reports, and other features of the service.

classes.name: AuditManagerClient
classes.description: A client class used to call methods of the AWS Audit Manager API. It extends AwsClient and provides structured method annotations for each API operation.

methods.name: associateAssessmentReportEvidenceFolder
methods.description: Associates a folder with assessment report evidence.

methods.name: batchCreateDelegationByAssessment
methods.description: Creates multiple delegations for an assessment.

methods.name: getAssessmentReportUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the URL for an assessment report.
